summary: Build a job tracker aggregating open accounting and analytics job postings from Big 4 and mid-size accounting firms.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal geometric logo mark with briefcase + bar-chart motif, warm neutral palette (job-tracker-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Empty-state illustration of a tidy desk with a checklist and a small chart, warm neutral palette (empty-tracker-illustration.dim_1200x800.png)

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity sign-in so each user can maintain their own job tracker data (saved jobs, application status, notes) tied to their principal.

Seed the app with an initial firm directory that includes the Big 4 (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) and supports adding/editing mid-size firms via an in-app admin-style UI (no external integrations required).

Build the core job board UI: a searchable, filterable list of open job postings with filters for firm, category (Accounting/Analytics), and location keyword. Each job must show title, firm, location, category, and a link to the posting URL.
Add a 'My Tracker' view that shows only jobs the signed-in user has saved, grouped or filterable by applicationStatus, with quick actions to update status and edit notes.

Provide a simple job ingestion workflow suitable for maintaining 'all open postings' without scraping: allow authorized users to create/edit/close job postings via UI and support bulk import by pasting CSV text (title, firmName, category, location, postingUrl, open).

Add lightweight analytics dashboards: (1) counts of open jobs by firm and by category, (2) counts of saved jobs by applicationStatus for the signed-in user, and (3) a trend indicator based on datePosted when available.

Apply a coherent visual theme across the app (layout, typography, component styling) suitable for an accounting/career-tracking tool: warm neutral palette (e.g., sand/cream/charcoal), clear data-dense tables/cards, and restrained accent color (not blue/purple).
Generate and include static visual assets for the app (logo and empty-state illustration) and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (do not route images through the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a job tracker that lists all open accounting and analytics job postings at Big 4 and mid-size accounting firms.

Create a backend data model and API for job postings, firms, and user tracking fields. Job posting fields must include: id, title, firmId, firmName, category (Accounting|Analytics), location (free text), postingUrl, datePosted (optional), employmentType (optional), and open/closed status. User tracking fields must include: saved (boolean), applicationStatus (Not applied|Applied|Interviewing|Offer|Rejected|Withdrawn), notes (text), and lastUpdated timestamp.
